newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toray, Daiichi Pharm to develop analgesic in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Toray, Daiichi Pharm to develop analgesic in Japan.

text.p: Toray Industries Inc said on Monday that it and Daiichi Pharmaceutical Co Ltd have agreed to conduct joint clinical trials in Japan for a non-narcotic analgesic, TRK-820.
Toray succeeded in synthesising TRK-820 in 1992 and it has since entered the second phase of the three-stage clinical trial process in Japan, Toray said in a statement.
It said Daiichi Pharmaceutical would join in conducting the clinical trails later in the second phase.
Toray is also developing the drug in the United States, where it has finished the first phase of clinical tests, it said.
Toray expects to have the new analgesic on the market in Japan by around 2005, a company spokeswoman said.
